title: Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed Confidence
problem_definition: Fixed-confidence best-arm identification, one-parameter bandit models with a unique best arm; delta-PAC strategies.
causal_assumptions: n/a (stochastic bandit; i.i.d. rewards per arm, independent arms)
statistical_estimator: Empirical means; Chernoff generalized-likelihood-ratio statistic Z_{a,b}(t)
allocation: Adaptive: Track-and-Stop (C-/D-tracking of optimal proportions w*(mu))
stopping_rule: Chernoff stopping rule with threshold beta(t,delta)=log(r(t)/delta); Bernoulli: log(2(K-1)t/delta) is delta-PAC (Thm 10)
confidence_or_coverage_guarantee: delta-PAC for any sampling rule (Prop 12, exp. families, C=C(alpha,K))
sample_complexity_results: Thm 1: E[tau]>=T*(mu)kl(delta,1-delta). Thm 14: limsup E[tau]/log(1/delta)<=alpha T*(mu). Asymptotic (delta->0) optimality.
reported_limitations: Asymptotic optimality only; forced exploration needed when best arm not unique; unique-best-arm assumption.
overlap_with_proposal: Statistical template for AFCR; our guarantee uses simpler union-bound bounds, NOT Track-and-Stop; we do not claim asymptotic optimality.

title: Which Agent Causes Task Failures and When? On Automated Failure Attribution of LLM Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Shaokun Zhang; Ming Yin; Jieyu Zhang; Jiale Liu; Zhiguang Han; Jingyang Zhang; Beibin Li; Chi Wang; Huazheng Wang; Yiran Chen; Qingyun Wu
problem_definition: Identify failure-responsible agent i* and decisive error step t* from a failure log.
causal_assumptions: Annotation-based notion of 'decisive error' (single decisive error); no formal causal model.
allocation: Non-statistical: all-at-once, step-by-step, binary search over the log
benchmarks: Who&When (127 multi-agent systems; algorithm-generated and hand-crafted)
baselines: Random; three LLM-judge methods; several LLMs incl. o1 and R1
reported_limitations: Best method ~53.5% agent-level, ~14.2% step-level accuracy; some methods below random.
overlap_with_proposal: Defines the task and benchmark; no overlap in method. Does NOT use Shapley estimation (that is CAR).

title: Causal Agent Replay: Counterfactual Attribution for LLM-Agent Failures
problem_definition: Which step caused the failure of an LLM-agent run; agent run as an SCM tau=(s0,(a1,o1),...,(an,on),y), y in [0,1].
causal_assumptions: Faithful replay of the exact state s_k; stochastic policy; outcome function user-supplied; total (not direct) effect through stochastic continuation; no common random numbers.
replay_or_intervention: Five do-operations: do_resample (null), do_action, do_observation, do_context, do_policy; run forward K times from the intervened state.
statistical_estimator: Contrastive: P(bad|do_resample k) with Wilson interval on proportion and bootstrap interval on the difference; budget-bounded MC permutation Shapley with antithetic pairing and normal-approx CIs.
allocation: Fixed K per step (non-adaptive); Shapley budget-bounded with circuit breaker, on demand only
stopping_rule: None (fixed K); locus = latest step whose effect CI excludes zero
confidence_or_coverage_guarantee: Per-estimate CIs only; no delta-PAC or sequential guarantee stated
benchmarks: Synthetic SCMs with planted ground truth only (pivotal step; two-step AND failure: phi0=0.44, phi1=0.45, efficiency sum 0.909 vs 0.91)
baselines: Single-step contrastive vs Shapley comparison; Who&When ~14% quoted from prior work
reported_limitations: Total effect; judge-based outcomes noisy; real tools with side effects out of scope; Shapley exponential worst case.
overlap_with_proposal: HIGH on estimand/replay (same-policy resampling, outcome distributions, run-forward confound); NONE on fixed-confidence stopping, adaptivity, prefix reuse, automata. Its no-cache rule motivates our validity conditions.

title: AgenTracer: Who Is Inducing Failure in the LLM Agentic Systems?
authors: Guibin Zhang; Junhao Wang; Junjie Chen; Wangchunshu Zhou; Kun Wang; Shuicheng Yan
problem_definition: Failure attribution; decisive step = earliest step whose oracle rectification flips failure to success.
causal_assumptions: Oracle rectification operator R(tau,t,a'_t) replaces action by an oracle/analyzer-proposed corrected action and re-simulates; single decisive error.
replay_or_intervention: Counterfactual replay with analyzer-agent corrections (has access to ground truth) + programmatic fault injection on successful trajectories
statistical_estimator: Binary outcome of a single replay per step (no estimator)
baselines: Proprietary and open reasoning LLMs as judges (e.g. Gemini-2.5-Pro, DeepSeek-R1)
public_implementation: No code link found on arXiv page
overlap_with_proposal: Replay as annotation oracle; second culprit definition (earliest). AFCR's first_above rule formalises it under sampling noise.

title: Conformal Agent Error Attribution
authors: Naihe Feng; Yi Sui; Shiyi Hou; Ga Wu; Jesse C. Cresswell
problem_definition: Predict a contiguous set of steps containing the decisive error with finite-sample coverage.
causal_assumptions: Exchangeability of calibration and test trajectories; single decisive error; labelled calibration data.
replay_or_intervention: None (scoring functions: LLM judges, role prompting, fine-tuned Qwen3-1.7B)
statistical_estimator: Split conformal with left/right/two-way filtration scores
confidence_or_coverage_guarantee: Marginal coverage 1-alpha <= P[y* in C] < 1-alpha+1/(n+1) (Thm 3.4) over trajectories
sample_complexity_results: None (inference cost NFE per test point reported)
benchmarks: Who&When (184 examples); GSM8K/MATH controlled injection (DyLAN, MacNet)
reported_limitations: Exchangeability; match algorithm to data distribution; single decisive-error assumption.
overlap_with_proposal: Orthogonal; marginal coverage vs per-trajectory identification; complementary (set -> replay).

causal_assumptions: Non-stationary interaction data; latent confounders handled by CDC-MAS (per text).
replay_or_intervention: Counterfactual simulation used for optimisation suggestions

title: CausalFlow: Causal Attribution and Counterfactual Repair for LLM Agent Failures
authors: Akash Bonagiri; Devang Borkar; Gerard Janno Anderias; Setareh Rafatirad; Houman Homayoun
problem_definition: Causal Responsibility Scores via step-level counterfactual intervention, then minimal repairs.
replay_or_intervention: Step-level interventions and edited repairs validated by outcome flip
benchmarks: Four: math reasoning, code generation, QA, medical browsing

title: Knowledge-Based Zero-Replay Debugging of Multi-Agent LLM Traces
authors: Hyeonjeong Cha; Daein Weon; Dong Ho Kang
problem_definition: Predict which events a replay oracle would mark high-effect, without replaying (zero-replay counterfactual-effect prediction).
replay_or_intervention: Remove-event interventions in a deterministic oracle used only for calibration/evaluation
statistical_estimator: Learning-to-rank gradient-boosted predictor over 13 knowledge-graph features
allocation: Static top-K replay agenda under a budget
confidence_or_coverage_guarantee: Calibration of predictor; no statistical stopping guarantee
reported_limitations: Characterises when cheap centrality suffices vs learned evidence.
overlap_with_proposal: Same cost motivation, different mechanism (prediction vs adaptive stochastic replay).

title: Localizing Emergent Failures in Agentic AI: Recovering Minimal Repair Families via Counterfactual Replay
authors: Bingjie Li; Yumeng Song; Zhongming Yao; Tianyi Li
problem_definition: Minimal Repair Family Recovery: all inclusion-minimal event sets whose replay restores success within a size bound.
causal_assumptions: Declared graph domain; fixed (deterministic) replay outcomes.
replay_or_intervention: Graph-constrained singleton and pair candidates verified by replay with paired clean counterparts
confidence_or_coverage_guarantee: Exact within declared graph domain for fixed replay outcomes (no probabilistic guarantee)
sample_complexity_results: Empirical: replay calls 56.3 -> 25.3 on 120-DAG benchmark; 21.0 -> 10.0 on 24-case LLM pilot
overlap_with_proposal: Handles joint causes (we do not); different cost-reduction route.

title: Repair or Resample? Rethinking Failure Debugging in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Zhongwen Luan; Xiaoyu Zhang; Yue Yang; Jiongchi Yu; Xiaohong Chen; Ming Hu
problem_definition: Do MAS repair methods causally repair or stochastically resample? SymTrace framework + SymFail dataset (536 annotated failures).
causal_assumptions: Faithful reconstruction of the prefix before an anchor from recorded logs.
replay_or_intervention: Snapshot + replay mode: reinject recorded results up to the anchor, regenerate downstream
statistical_estimator: Rates with Wilson CIs; paired bootstrap; McNemar; Holm (evaluation only)
overlap_with_proposal: Prefix reconstruction for replay FIDELITY; no cross-candidate reuse of rollouts found.

title: Information Complexity in Bandit Subset Selection
problem_definition: Explore-m (PAC/fixed-budget subset selection) with KL confidence regions.
allocation: KL-LUCB (sample lowest-LCB selected arm and highest-UCB non-selected arm) and KL-Racing
confidence_or_coverage_guarantee: Thm 1: delta-PAC with beta=log(k1 K t^alpha/delta)+loglog(...), alpha>1, k1>2e+1+e/(alpha-1)+(e+1)/(alpha-1)^2
overlap_with_proposal: Source of the KL-LUCB baseline implemented in this repo.
